'''Assault Team One''', along with [[Assault Team Two]], was ordered, by [[Force Commander]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] of the [[Chiss Expansionary Fleet/Legends|Chiss Expansionary Fleet]], to perform an out-hull operation on a [[Vagaari/Legends|Vagaari]] [[Gravity well projector/Legends|gravity projector's]] starboard side during the [[Battle of Geroon|Battle of the Geroon homeworld]]. They then located and neutralized the crew aboard the projector with minimal damage to the projector itself. After that they assisted [[Chief engineer/Legends|Chief Engineer]] [[Yal'avi'kema]] in collapsing the projector.<ref name="OBF" />
